candidate_workaround: Resolve the phase root against the repository before invoking the Meta Tool Box build command.
failure_signature: A relative phase-root argument resolves against the shell working directory and produces a structurally valid but unintended zero-card catalogue.
recurrence_guard: Pass an absolute repository-bound phase root and require the expected nonzero card count before credit.
rollback: Retain the zero-card refusal, change only the path binding, and rerun the bounded catalogue step.
title: Bind Meta Tool Box phase roots to the repository
trigger_preconditions: caller shell working directory differs from repository root
